mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_institutional_trade (stock_id, trade_date, foreign_buy_shares, foreign_sell_shares, foreign_net_shares, foreign_dealer_buy_shares, foreign_dealer_sell_shares, foreign_dealer_net_shares, trust_buy_shares, trust_sell_shares, trust_net_shares, dealer_net_shares, dealer_self_buy_shares, dealer_self_sell_shares, dealer_self_net_shares, dealer_hedge_buy_shares, dealer_hedge_sell_shares, dealer_hedge_net_shares, total_net_shares, source) VALUES (#{stockId}, #{tradeDate}, #{foreignBuyShares}, #{foreignSellShares}, #{foreignNetShares}, #{foreignDealerBuyShares}, #{foreignDealerSellShares}, #{foreignDealerNetShares}, #{trustBuyShares}, #{trustSellShares}, #{trustNetShares}, #{dealerNetShares}, #{dealerSelfBuyShares}, #{dealerSelfSellShares}, #{dealerSelfNetShares}, #{dealerHedgeBuyShares}, #{dealerHedgeSellShares}, #{dealerHedgeNetShares}, #{totalNetShares}, #{source}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE foreign_buy_shares = VALUES(foreign_buy_shares), foreign_sell_shares = VALUES(foreign_sell_shares), foreign_net_shares = VALUES(foreign_net_shares), foreign_dealer_buy_shares = VALUES(foreign_dealer_buy_shares), foreign_dealer_sell_shares = VALUES(foreign_dealer_sell_shares), foreign_dealer_net_shares = VALUES(foreign_dealer_net_shares), trust_buy_shares = VALUES(trust_buy_shares), trust_sell_shares = VALUES(trust_sell_shares), trust_net_shares = VALUES(trust_net_shares), dealer_net_shares = VALUES(dealer_net_shares), dealer_self_buy_shares = VALUES(dealer_self_buy_shares), dealer_self_sell_shares = VALUES(dealer_self_sell_shares), dealer_self_net_shares = VALUES(dealer_self_net_shares), dealer_hedge_buy_shares = VALUES(dealer_hedge_buy_shares), dealer_hedge_sell_shares = VALUES(dealer_hedge_sell_shares), dealer_hedge_net_shares = VALUES(dealer_hedge_net_shares), total_net_shares = VALUES(total_net_shares), source = VALUES(source)
mapper.select: SELECT stock_id, trade_date, foreign_buy_shares, foreign_sell_shares, foreign_net_shares, foreign_dealer_buy_shares, foreign_dealer_sell_shares, foreign_dealer_net_shares, trust_buy_shares, trust_sell_shares, trust_net_shares, dealer_net_shares, dealer_self_buy_shares, dealer_self_sell_shares, dealer_self_net_shares, dealer_hedge_buy_shares, dealer_hedge_sell_shares, dealer_hedge_net_shares, total_net_shares, source FROM stock_institutional_trade WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND trade_date = #{tradeDate}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_institutional_trade WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate}

SELECT DISTINCT dp.trade_date FROM stock_daily_price dp WHERE dp.trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_institutional_trade it WHERE it.trade_date = dp.trade_date ) ORDER BY dp.trade_date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT trade_date FROM stock_institutional_trade WHERE trade_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY trade_date ASC
